crossRefs.note: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says…
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make, and I will spare them, as a man…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, tell him, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,
translations.bsb: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
translations.kjv: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;
translations.asv: But unto the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Jehovah, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: As touching the words which thou hast heard,
